design_philosophy: Information clarity, functional beauty, and objective data presentation. The dashboard serves as a 'Command Center' for monitoring real-time public transport delays. We prioritize data density, high-contrast typography, and strict functional colors over decorative elements.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Data metrics and numbers MUST use mono_font for vertical alignment.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch to match neighbors.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.
Use flex-col to align internal card contents.
No jagged bottoms in grid rows.

components.cards: Cardless or Flat Rectangular. Max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm). 1px solid border (border-border). No default shadows.
components.buttons: Sharp edges. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black for primary buttons).
components.charts: Recharts. Remove default cartesian grid backgrounds. Use solid, high-contrast lines. Tooltips must use 'Crystal Glass' style (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80 border border-white/10).
components.tables: Dense rows. Sticky header with Glassmorphism if scrolling. 1px bottom border per row. Mono font for data cells.
components.status_indicators: Glowing dot (framer-motion pulsing) + Text label. Green for 'Live/Healthy', Red for 'Pipeline Down'.

surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass variant: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.widgets: Grid Borders style: border-collapse layout, subtle borders between metrics.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color brighten.
motion.charts: Animate on mount. Smooth transitions on data update.
motion.live_data: Subtle flash or highlight when a real-time prediction updates.

image_urls.description: Subtle train/skyline image. Use only as a highly desaturated, low-opacity (10%) background texture in the top header or empty states, NOT as a hero banner.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Stroke width 1.5. Sizes: 16px for labels, 24px for primary actions, 32px+ for empty states.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use Text Shadow over gradients/images.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard in Dark Mode strictly following the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn Cards with soft rounded corners and shadows. Override Shadcn Card to be rounded-none or rounded-sm, bg-transparent or bg-[#141414], with a 1px border-[#2A2A2A].
Top row should contain Stats Cards (Models count, Active Routes, Data Points, Accuracy) and the Pipeline Status Indicator.
Middle section must include the Route Selector (Bus/Train, City) and a prominent 'Real-Time Delay Prediction' display using a large Mono font.
Bottom section should house the Historical Trends Chart (Area Chart) and Model Performance Comparison (RMSE/MAE Bar Charts).
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='route-selector-dropdown', data-testid='prediction-display').
Add 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' to Google Fonts import in index.css.
Inject the defined color palette into tailwind.config.js dark theme section.
